explanation: Store each pushed value together with the maximum among all entries up to that depth. Pop discards the top pair, and Max reads its cached maximum. Every Stack constructor command clears the previous state, including commands in the middle of a sequence.
timeComplexity: O(1) per Push, Pop, Empty and Max operation. Initialize releases O(n) previous entries.
spaceComplexity: O(n) space for n live stack entries.
attribution: Original EPI Practice C++ implementation and reset-aware operation wrapper, independently authored from the public problem contract and repository-authored C# algorithm. Uses the unchanged local EPI Judge serialization and test framework APIs; upstream reference sources are not modified.
